name: changeOrigin_eval_of_finite
statement: FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F) {n : ℕ} (hn : ∀ (m : ℕ), n ≤ m → p m = 0) (x y : E) : (p.changeOrigin x).sum y = p.sum (x + y)

have_tree.type: HasSum (f ⟨k, l, ·⟩) (changeOriginSeries p k l (fun _ ↦ x) fun _ ↦ y)

children.type: m ∉ Finset.range n) : changeOriginSeries p k m (fun _ ↦ x) = 0
